subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: After cleanup and current-main integration, does the exact migration candidate sufficiently prove legacy upgrade, recovery, channel continuity, and bundled Codex continuity to approve the one-way SQLite flip?
rationale: This protected PR changes persistent user state and external Plugin SDK boundaries; unit tests, CI, and an uninspectable temporary smoke directory cannot establish final upgrade safety without owner judgment.

options.title: Require cleaned exact-head proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the rebased branch has a publishable redacted upgrade artifact and direct owner review of Plugin SDK and bundled Codex behavior.

options.title: Accept reported evidence
options.body: Approve based on the extensive tests, green CI, and contributor-reported smoke results despite the uninspectable artifact and Codex contract-review gap.

recommendation.title: Require cleaned exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the rebased branch has a publishable redacted upgrade artifact and direct owner review of Plugin SDK and bundled Codex behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent current-main session work and broad central-path history make him the strongest available owner for the final integration and proof decision.
